definition: Document clustering (or text clustering) is the application of cluster analysis to textual documents.
details: It has applications in automatic document organization, topic extraction and fast information retrieval or filtering.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. And that, done honestly, is Document clustering.
